H5P Tester Items

This assessment is a final integration target for five self-hosted H5P interaction types: Multiple Choice, Fill in the Blanks, Drag and Drop, Drag the Words, and True/False.

Each trial should render an H5P activity, let the H5P runtime define the learner interaction, and let MoFaCTS ingest the H5P runtime event data into normalized assessment history. The drag-and-drop item is the key multi-row target: each learner placement should become an ordered history-write candidate with placement correctness and latency since the previous H5P event.

H5P tester assessment complete.

Your H5P activity events should have been ingested and recorded. This system is intended to support development and QA of self-hosted H5P playback, event ingestion, normalization, and history logging behavior.
